note: Sapper's Path portal build (lane P, tools/portal-build.mjs, tools/portal-selftest.mjs; tools/portal-notes.md). CrazyGames Basic Launch with no SDK: the whole build counts. out: the gitignored folder the build writes (the staged copy, the zip, build.json). maxBytes: the mobile-homepage line read two ways (20 MiB and 20 MB; the build fails past the lower); maxFiles: the portal's file cap. debugOnly: files the code fetches only under ?debug=1, left out of the zip on purpose (portal-selftest serves them from the source tree for its selfTest run only). companions: shipped though never fetched (the font's own licence must travel with it). licences: the plain-text credits generated from LICENSES.md. stripMeta: index.html <meta> lines dropped from the copy (the social-card tags carry the pf-builds URL). banned: words that must not appear in the build's runtime files (case-insensitive; itch as itch.io so 'switch' passes); allowUrls: the one absolute URL runtime files may hold (the SVG namespace inside data: URIs, never fetched).
name: sappers-path-crazygames
